title: Kenyan Garlic Stew
description: A flavorful stew originating from Kenya that combines the spices and herbs of the region with the pungency of garlic. This hearty dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add chopped garlicky and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add chopped stew and crunchy, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
